name: agent-runner

surface.GET /version: R5: 200 {ok: true, name: "agent-runner", version, deployment, image_digest_declared, capabilities}
surface.POST /run: R43, R44, R45, R47, R49, R57, R58, R60: {declared, key, tiers, parts, ceiling, estimate} -> 202 {ok: true, run, state: "running"}
surface.GET /run/status: R43, R51: 200 {ok: true, state, tier, items_done, items_total, incomplete_reason?}
surface.GET /run/manifest: R43, R53, R54: the plaintext manifest once the run is done or incomplete; 409 NO_MANIFEST_YET before
surface.POST /run/approve: R43, R54: 200 {ok: true, state: "approved"} once the manifest was shown; 409 MANIFEST_NOT_SHOWN before
surface.GET /run/bundle: R43, R52, R53, R54: the sealed bundle bytes after approval; 409 MANIFEST_NOT_SHOWN before, SECRET_IN_PAYLOAD when none was made
surface.POST /run/discard: R43, R55: 200 {ok: true, state: "discarded"}; the run wiped

build.dependencies: none: the image copies dist/image/ (scripts/build-image.mjs), installs no package and runs no install script (R16)
build.machine_run: docker run --rm --read-only --tmpfs /tmp -e DEPLOYMENT=machine -p 127.0.0.1:8080:8080 <repository>@<digest> (R58: the key goes in the POST /run body, never an environment variable or a mounted file; no volume; one port)

note: The fleet-member marker of a container member (R7, R14). `entry` is the image's Node entry; `bundle` is the Worker hosting its class (`src/worker.mjs`, R12). `image.digest` is written by the release when it publishes the image (T33-D1), with the same digest in `wrangler.jsonc`'s `containers[0].image`. `deployment` is this configuration's (R57): team, machine or civicsmith. `egress` is empty here: the class applies the issuer host alone at rest, read from ai-catalogue's CATALOGUE_ADDRESS, and for a run the issuer and the declared provider host (R45); naming the issuer host here waits on a ruling (R10, R11). `bind` is unchanged until BOB names the binding that replaces agent-worker's retired RUNNER (R14).
